title: Editor crash when inspecting 2 Objects handled by the same plugin, caused by corrupted ObjectID
body:
### Tested versions

4.4

### System information

W10

### Issue description

When trying to edit 2 objects handled by the same plugin (e.g. by unfolding them in the inspector), the editor may sometimes print an error:
```
Condition "slot >= slot_max" is true. Returning nullptr.
```
It comes from here, and judging from the comment, it's not supposed to happen:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/cae3d722a3abd6d93d84a84beccc65a78948653f/core/object/object.h#L1047

And indeed, the ObjectID is corrupted, because sometimes you'll get this crash:
```
CrashHandlerException: Program crashed
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5.dev.custom_build (caa59c5611ee77a574d4eaf957f264ceeb17cbd3)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
[0] ObjectID::operator!= (C:\godot_source\core\object\object_id.h:51)
[1] EditorNode::edit_item (C:\godot_source\editor\editor_node.cpp:2413)
[2] call_with_variant_args_helper<EditorNode,Object *,Object *,0,1> (C:\godot_source\core\variant\binder_common.h:319)
[3] call_with_variant_args<EditorNode,Object *,Object *> (C:\godot_source\core\variant\binder_common.h:429)
[4] CallableCustomMethodPointer<EditorNode,void,Object *,Object *>::call (C:\godot_source\core\object\callable_method_pointer.h:108)
[5] Callable::callp (C:\godot_source\core\variant\callable.cpp:58)
[6] CallQueue::_call_function (C:\godot_source\core\object\message_queue.cpp:221)
[7] CallQueue::flush (C:\godot_source\core\object\message_queue.cpp:270)
[8] SceneTree::physics_process (C:\godot_source\scene\main\scene_tree.cpp:537)
[9] Main::iteration (C:\godot_source\main\main.cpp:4462)
[10] OS_Windows::run (C:\godot_source\platform\windows\os_windows.cpp:2075)
[11] widechar_main (C:\godot_source\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:97)
[12] _main (C:\godot_source\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:122)
[13] main (C:\godot_source\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:136)
[14] WinMain (C:\godot_source\platform\windows\godot_windows.cpp:150)
[15] __scrt_common_main_seh (D:\a\_work\1\s\src\vctools\crt\vcstartup\src\startup\exe_common.inl:288)
[16] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
-- END OF BACKTRACE --
```
The error and crash seem to be random, not sure what exactly causes them.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP
2. In Sample_Scene click the root node and open C 1 Resource
3. Open C 2. C 1 should close with an error
4. Try opening both resources and/or re-selecting the node
5. Sometimes crash or error
